units.source_text: The Protector keeps watch inside you as well.
units.output_text: Did you know that you have a Protector inside of you?

units.source_text: When fear, rage, craving or shame comes on hard, the feeling can stay at full strength and still not get to decide what you say or send, what you spend or take, or who you sleep with or commit to.
units.output_text: When you’re emotionally triggered (in fear, rage, craving, shame etc), the intensity may be at full tilt but you still have the ability not to let it run your mouth or fingers (when emailing, spending, taking etc) or to make life choices (who you sleep with, commitment etc).

units.source_text: It will usually tell you it has to be now.
units.output_text: Usually, your Protector wants to do things NOW.
